title: WordPress Copilot Advanced
pitch: Map an existing WordPress website, maintain its context and implement checked changes within its current architecture.

flow.d: Read the actual theme, components, data and delivery rules.
Build evidence-backed site context and record unknowns.
Reuse the existing stack and component conventions.
Check the rendered result and follow the project release contract.
